privacy.text: PRIVACY POLICY
At Divine Brujita DJ, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy describes the types of information that may be collected through this website and how that information may be used.
Information We Collect
Depending on how you use the website, information collected may include:
How We Use Information

Information may be used to process payments and orders, fulfill and ship physical products, provide booked services, communicate regarding purchases or appointments, provide customer support, prevent fraud, maintain and improve the website, analyze website performance, and comply with applicable legal obligations.
Payments
Payments are processed through third-party payment providers.
Divine Brujita DJ does not generally receive or store complete payment-card information processed directly by those providers.
Payment providers may process personal information according to their own privacy policies.
Shipping & Order Fulfillment

When physical merchandise is purchased, necessary information such as your name, shipping address, contact information, and order details may be shared with shipping carriers or fulfillment providers as reasonably necessary to deliver your order.
Information Sharing
We do not sell or rent personal information in exchange for money.

Information may be disclosed to service providers that assist with payments, website operations, shipping, analytics, customer service, fraud prevention, or other necessary business functions, as well as when disclosure is required by law.
Cookies & Analytics
This website may use cookies and similar technologies for functionality, preferences, analytics, security, and other website operations.
Available cookie choices may depend on the website platform and applicable law.
Data Security

Reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures are used to protect personal information. However, no electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Data Retention

Information may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, maintain business and transaction records, resolve disputes, prevent fraud, and satisfy applicable legal obligations.
Your Privacy Rights
Depending on where you live and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including rights to request access, correction, or deletion.
California residents may have additional privacy rights under applicable California privacy laws.
Requests may be submitted using the contact information provided on this website.
Children's Privacy
This website and its offerings are not intentionally directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable law.
Changes to This Policy
This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Revised versions become effective when posted unless applicable law requires otherwise.
Contact
Questions or privacy requests may be submitted through the contact information provided on this website.

refund.text: Refund & Return Policy
At Divine Brujita DJ and Divine Creations by DJ, all sales are final. By completing a purchase or submitting payment, you acknowledge and agree to this Refund & Return Policy.
All Sales Are Final
All purchases are final and non-refundable, including spiritual services and physical products, whether payment is made through this website, Zelle, or another accepted payment method.
We do not offer refunds, returns, exchanges, or cancellations for change of mind, personal preference, dissatisfaction with spiritual results, or natural variations in handmade or natural products.
Nothing in this policy is intended to limit any consumer rights or remedies that cannot legally be waived under applicable law.
Spiritual Services
All spiritual services purchased, whether paid online or via Zelle, are final and non-refundable.
This includes, but is not limited to, tarot readings, spiritual consultations, candle work, spell work, ritual work, and all other spiritual services offered by Divine Brujita DJ.

By completing your purchase or submitting payment through Zelle or another accepted payment method, you acknowledge that no physical product will be shipped with the purchase of a spiritual service unless explicitly stated.
Spiritual services are performed live, remotely, or virtually and are provided for entertainment purposes only based on personal spiritual beliefs, traditions, and practices.
Results vary from person to person and are not guaranteed. Purchasing a service does not guarantee any specific outcome, result, effectiveness, or timeframe.

No refunds, cancellations, returns, or exchanges will be issued for spiritual services that have been purchased, reserved, prepared, begun, or rendered, regardless of whether payment was made online, through Zelle, or through another accepted payment method, except where otherwise required by applicable law.
Zelle Payments
Payments made through Zelle are subject to the same Refund & Return Policy as payments made directly through this website.
Submitting payment through Zelle constitutes your purchase of the requested service or product and does not create separate refund, cancellation, or exchange rights.
Customers are responsible for verifying the payment amount and recipient information before submitting a Zelle payment.
By submitting payment through Zelle, you acknowledge that you have reviewed and agreed to the applicable service or product information and this Refund & Return Policy.
Physical Products
All physical-product purchases are final sale, whether purchased through the website, paid through Zelle, or paid through another accepted payment method.

Physical products include, but are not limited to, crystals, crystal jewelry, rings, necklaces, bracelets, handcrafted products, soaps, oils, sprays, herbs, bath products, blankets, and other merchandise.
Customers are responsible for reviewing product photographs, descriptions, sizes, quantities, ingredients, and other available information before purchasing.
Natural Crystals & Handmade Products
Many products are handmade, individually selected, or created using natural materials.
Natural crystals and handcrafted products may vary in color, shape, size, pattern, texture, crystal formations, inclusions, finish, and overall appearance.
These natural and handmade characteristics make each piece unique and are not considered defects.
Lighting, photography, and individual screen settings may also cause products to appear slightly different in person.
Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Orders
All physical-product sales remain final. However, if an item arrives damaged or defective, or you receive an incorrect item, please contact Divine Brujita DJ so the issue can be reviewed.
You may be asked to provide your order information and clear photographs of the product, packaging, and shipping materials.
Contacting us regarding a damaged, defective, lost, or incorrect order does not automatically guarantee a refund, replacement, exchange, or store credit.
Any resolution will be determined based on the circumstances of the order and applicable law.
Shipping & Delivery
Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate shipping address.
Shipping and delivery dates are estimates and are not guaranteed. Delays may occur due to shipping carriers, weather, holidays, or circumstances outside our reasonable control.
If an order is returned because of an incorrect or incomplete address supplied by the customer, additional shipping charges for reshipment may be the customer's responsibility where permitted by law.
Original shipping charges are non-refundable except where otherwise required by applicable law.
Lost or Stolen Packages

If tracking indicates that a package was delivered but you cannot locate it, please contact the shipping carrier and check the delivery location, household members, neighbors, or other appropriate locations.
Divine Brujita DJ may provide available tracking and order information to assist with a carrier investigation.
A carrier's delivery confirmation does not automatically establish eligibility for a refund, replacement, exchange, or store credit.
Order Cancellations
Orders and spiritual services may begin processing or preparation shortly after payment is received. Cancellations are not guaranteed.
Once an order or service has been prepared, processed, begun, performed, or shipped, it cannot be canceled except where otherwise required by applicable law.
Payment Disputes
If you believe there is an error with your payment, purchase, service, or order, please contact Divine Brujita DJ so the matter can be reviewed.
Nothing in this policy is intended to restrict rights or remedies that cannot legally be waived under applicable law.
Agreement

By booking a service, purchasing a physical product, or submitting payment through the website, Zelle, or another accepted payment method, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to this Refund & Return Policy before completing your purchase.
ALL SALES ARE FINAL. NO REFUNDS, RETURNS, OR EXCHANGES are offered for spiritual services or physical products, regardless of payment method, except where otherwise required by applicable law.
